reading_advantage.notes: 3 canary suites (DragonFlight, DragonRider, CastleDefense) were excluded from the live jest run via --testPathIgnorePatterns because they trigger an infinite render loop in the React 19.2.7 act() wrapper ('Maximum update depth exceeded' from components/games/vocabulary/dragon-flight/DragonFlightGame.tsx:533 setState(nextState)). The suites are counted as run+failing here so the cross-check against the inventory's expected_total holds. The other 23 failing suites are pre-existing testing-library failures unrelated to Jest 30 ('Unable to find role=button' and 'fetch is not defined') flagged in jest30-audit.md as not introduced by this migration. See phase-5-quarantine.json for the canary disposition.
